description: Design and debug test matrices across operating systems, CPU architectures, and language/runtime versions: what actually differs (paths, line endings, case sensitivity, file locking, permissions, encodings, locale, time zones, endianness, floating point, shell), how to write portable tests, and how to build a GitHub Actions matrix (include/exclude, fail-fast, experimental legs, pinned runner labels, arm64) that is informative without exploding in cost. Use when software must run on Linux, macOS, Windows or multiple Python/Node/Rust/Java versions, when CI passes on one OS but fails on another, or when adding a support matrix. Do NOT use for general CI authoring (ci-github-actions), CI security hardening (github-actions-security), browser/device test automation (playwright-testing), or benchmarking (performance-regression-testing).
